dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' shaped structures exhibit sharp, high-contrast outer perimeters with a rapid gradient transition from dark exterior pixels to light-gray/white centers. Most prominent structures are approximately circular with wall thicknesses varying between 2-5 pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of localized, solid high-intensity pixel clusters is observed along the lower lateral flank. These clusters appear as asymmetrical, non-gradient blotches that contrast with the more structured annuli on the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A linear vertical chain is formed by the centroids of three primary annuli in the center-dorsal region. An additional triangular geometric relationship is formed by the centroids of a cluster of three rings located on the upper-right posterior quadrant.

other_distinctive_markers: A localized cluster of green vegetation (grass) is present, occluding the pixel data of the lower right posterior flank.
